decision.reason: A bounded, revocable completion-verdict entry reuses the existing evidence verifier: approved only on completed evidence, out-of-scope tasks get no verdict, only approved produces one node->done transition, revocation restores the prior status, and the record carries no publish/product-lock authority. Six verdict tests + five verifier tests pass.

verdictEntry.authority: reuses evaluateEvidenceVerifier (evidence-verifier.ts); no second permission layer
verdictEntry.bounded: verdict only for taskIds in scope; otherwise out-of-scope with no transition
verdictEntry.transition: only approved -> { nodeId: taskId, from: priorStatus, to: 'done' } via the existing task-ledger status_changed source

residual.assembly: The entry returns the verdict + transition/revocation description; wiring it into the Electron main task-ledger service call site is integration-layer work (not in this packet's ownedPaths).
residual.scope: Bounded to scope.taskIds; no publish/product-lock/release capability; product defaults/locks/approval unchanged.

independentVerification.detail: Tests cover approved/insufficient/out-of-scope/revoke, digest-only record shape (no content/publish/lock fields), and determinism (same evidence -> same digest). No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Reuses evaluateEvidenceVerifier; no second verifier authority layer.
Only scope.taskIds receive a verdict; out-of-scope tasks get out-of-scope and no transition.
Only approved yields { nodeId, from: priorStatus, to: 'done' }; other verdicts never transition.
Record carries taskId/verdict/evidenceDigest/findingCodes/priorStatus only; no raw evidence content.
Revocation restores the recorded priorStatus; non-approved verdicts have nothing to revoke.
Record explicitly grantsPublish=false and grantsProductLock=false; no release capability.
Same evidence -> same evidenceDigest and identical record (replay-safe).
6 new + 5 regression tests pass, tsgo:core 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: Electron main assembly of the verdict entry.
A separate second-agent independent verifier role.
